downloadTitle: Update for Microsoft SharePoint Workflow Manager (KB5002864)
downloadDescription: Update for Microsoft SharePoint Workflow Manager (KB5002864)
detailsSection: This update provides the latest fixes to Microsoft SharePoint Workflow Manager. Additionally, this update contains stability and performance improvements.oft SharePoint Workflow Manager (KB5002864)
systemRequirementsSection:
Prerequisites

To apply this update, you must have the SharePoint Workflow Manager Client (16.0.19725.20522) installed.

Restart information

You might have to restart the computer after you install this update.
installInstructionSection:
To install the update completely, follow these steps.

For the existing farm
Uninstall the old SharePoint Workflow Manager (SPWFM) Client.
Install the new SPWFM Client (16.0.19725.20522).
Install the update for SharePoint Workflow Manager (KB5002864).
Restart the computer, if it's necessary.
Run Upgrade Workflow Manager Farm in the Workflow Manager Configuration Wizard.
For the new farm
Install the SharePoint Workflow Manager RTM.
Install the SPWFM Client (16.0.19725.20522).
Install the update for SharePoint Workflow Manager (KB5002864).
To create the farm, run the Workflow Manager Configuration Wizard.
Note

You must install the update for SharePoint Workflow Manager (KB5002864) on all servers in the Workflow Manager farm.
You must uninstall the old SharePoint Workflow Manager Client from all servers in the Workflow Manager farm and SharePoint Server farm.
You must install the new SharePoint Workflow Manager Client on all servers in the Workflow Manager farm and SharePoint Server farm.
